script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

Title: Second Chances

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYMNASIUM - DAY

Coach WILLIAMS (mid-50s, stern but caring) stands in front of a team of DISHEARTENED PLAYERS, aged 15-18, who sit on the BLEACHERS.

COACH WILLIAMS
Gentlemen, I've coached many teams in my career. But I've never seen a team as demoralized as this one. I know we've had our struggles, but I believe in each and every one of you.

The door swings open and in walks LUCAS (17, tall, muscular, and brooding), the team's star player who was expelled for a fight last season.

LUCAS
(quietly)
Coach.

COACH WILLIAMS
(smiling)
Lucas. We're glad to have you back.

Lucas takes a seat next to ALEX (16, short, glasses, and quick-witted), the team's utility player who had a crush on Lucas since childhood.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYMNASIUM - LATER

The team is practicing passing drills. They struggle, their passes missing each other. The atmosphere is tense.

COACH WILLIAMS
(yelling)
Focus! Pay attention to the ball!

Alex tosses the ball to Lucas, who catches it easily. The team looks at him in awe. Lucas tosses the ball back to Alex.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL CAFETERIA - DAY

The team sits at their usual table in the corner. Lucas sits beside Alex, who seems nervous.

ALEX
(whispers)
I'm glad you're back, Lucas. We all missed you.

LUCAS
(quietly)
I missed you too, Alex.

They share an awkward moment.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYMNASIUM - EVENING

The team is practicing a new play. They fumble through it, but eventually, they get it right. Lucas and Alex work together seamlessly.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL LIBRARY - DAY

Alex approaches Lucas, who is studying. They sit down next to each other.

ALEX
(awkwardly)
Lucas, do you remember that fight last year?

LUCAS
(nods)
I made a mistake. I'm sorry.

Alex hesitates, then speaks.

ALEX
I forgive you.

They share a moment of understanding.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYMNASIUM - NIGHT

The team is practicing for their upcoming game. They've come together, working as a cohesive unit. Coach Williams watches proudly.

COACH WILLIAMS
(whispers to himself)
Second chances.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYMNASIUM - GAME DAY

The team takes the court, Lucas and Alex as starters. They play with passion and grace, their teamwork unmatched.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYMNASIUM - POST-GAME

The team gathers around their coach, who smiles at them.

COACH WILLIAMS
Today, we proved that second chances are possible, not just in sports, but in life.

The team cheers, their spirits renewed.

FADE OUT.

End screenplay.
